PA5/PA6/PA7 are inputs (DDRA=0x1F) read together as PORTA & 0xE0. With 0x08B1 bit 0x80 set and a repeated matching read: 0x80 invokes the full-range checksum test; 0x00 enters an interrupt-masked infinite loop; 0x40 enters a destructive RAM-pattern test (0x5555 / 0xAAAA over 0x0800–0x0FFE). Other patterns do not enter these tests. These are application service/test selections, not the MCU hardware mode pins. External straps or test-point routing are unconfirmed.

connector.target_scope: Manual reference for 2004 XT660R/X, correlated with the supplied 2005-labelled image; exact ECU part number is unconfirmed.
connector.orientation: As drawn in the manual, with the small tab symbol above. The inspected drawing does not state mating-face versus wire-entry view. Do not mirror or assign OEM numbers without establishing that view.

A communication/fault override preserves the previous output; reset handling at 0xC6AD clears it. This is a real output path, but the attached device is not identified. The manual oxygen-heater circuit is a comparison lead, not a proved PB5-to-heater connection.

flash_comparison.source_numbering: Sketch numbering only; view side is not stated.
flash_comparison.finding: All three coloured terminals agree with the 34-position 2007 manual only under horizontal reflection. This is a consistent orientation hypothesis, not OEM numbering or an approved bench-wiring procedure.
flash_comparison.early_finding: The 34-position sketch does not match the early 26-position drawing. Do not transfer its 3 / 7 / 12 numbers to the early ECU.
flash_comparison.route_status: SCI0 is verified in the five populated boots; SCI1 is verified in all applications. The sketch labels K-line but does not establish which transceiver route reaches SCI0, SCI1, or both.
